summary.text: Daniel Elliott is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 54 since 2016 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Elliott is an attorney who chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Elliott was born in Danville, Kentucky, and graduated from Boyle County High School.
He earned a bachelor of arts from Bellarmine University and a law degree from the University of Louisville, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
He has been a member of the Perryville Battlefield Commission, the Lake Cumberland Area Development Board of Directors, and the Council of State Governments Intergovernmental Affairs Commission.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the House Judiciary Committee and also served on the Economic Development & Workforce Investment, Families and Children, and Transportation committees.
